I find the 5 second claim a but suspect. It took me about 30 in R :)

Anyway, you must learn to melt. ggplot needs data in the "long" as
opposed to "wide" format. Once you've done this the rest is easy:

library(ggplot2)
dat.m <- melt(dat, id.vars = "Grp")
levels(dat.m$Grp) <- rev(levels(dat.m$Grp))
ggplot(dat.m, aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = Grp)) +
geom_bar(position = "fill") +
scale_y_continuous(formatter = "percent")

Best,
Ista
